meta.name: Autoresearch
meta.description: Requires the Research app (@ryu/research) to be enabled — it provides the research.* tools this loop drives, and they do not exist on a node where the app is off. A researcher agent iterates on an experiment via those tools, keeping only improvements — a git-versioned autoresearch loop.

primary.name: Autoresearch (git-ledger loop)
primary.description: A researcher agent loops over the research sidecar — propose an edit, run, keep-if-improved-else-reset, append the ledger — inside a durable budget loop.

bodies.name: Autoresearch iteration
bodies.description: One researcher iteration: read → edit → run → keep/reset → ledger.

nodes.task:
You are an autonomous ML researcher. Minimize the experiment's `val_bpb` (lower is better) by looping with the research.* tools:
1. research.init_workspace {"experiment":"toy"} to get a workspace_id, the mutable_files, and program_md (follow it).
2. research.read_file the mutable train.py and study its hyperparameters.
3. Form ONE small hypothesis, then research.write_file the edited train.py.
4. research.run {workspace_id} — read back score, status, memory_gb.
5. If status==ok AND score improved on the best so far: research.keep; else research.reset.
6. research.ledger {workspace_id, commit, score, memory_gb, status, description} to log the attempt.
7. Repeat with a new hypothesis. Change one thing at a time; never stop until told.
